title.en: In a café / in a bar / in a restaurant

summary: Translation exercise: 28 café/bar orders in English to say in Finnish using the partitive after numbers and for quantities, with vocabulary given in brackets.
transcript:
KAHVILASSA (IN A CAFE) / BAARISSA (IN A BAR) / RAVINTOLASSA (IN A RESTAURANT)

KUINKA SINÄ SANOT SUOMEKSI (HOW DO YOU SAY IN FINNISH):

1. ONE COFFEE, PLEASE?

2. ONE BLACK COFFEE, PLEASE? (BLACK= MUSTA)

3. TWO COFFEES, PLEASE?

4. TWO LARGE COFFEES, PLEASE? (LARGE= ISO)

5. THREE LARGE BLACK COFFEES, PLEASE?

6. A GLASS OF WATER, PLEASE?

7. TWO GLASSES OF WATER, PLEASE?

8. A LARGE GLASS OF BEER, PLEASE?

9. TWO LARGE GLASSES OF BEER, PLEASE?

10. FOUR COLD CIDERS, PLEASE? (COLD= KYLMÄ)

11. THREE PINTS OF BEER, PLEASE? (PINT= TUOPPI)

12. THREE BOTTLES OF OLVI, PLEASE? (”OLVI” IS A FINNISH BRAND OF BEER)

13. A PIECE OF CHOCOLATE CAKE, PLEASE? (PIECE= PALA, CHOC CAKE= SUKLAAKAKKU)

14. A SMALL COFFEE AND TWO TEAS, PLEASE?

15. TWO FRESH CINNAMON BUNS AND TWO APPLE JUICES, PLEASE? (FRESH= TUORE, CINNAMON BUN= KORVAPUUSTI, APPLE JUICE= OMENAMEHU)

16. THREE WARM KARELIAN PIES AND TWO GLASSES OF WATER, PLEASE? (WARM= LÄMMIN, KARELIAN PIE= KARJALANPIIRAKKA / RIISIPIIRAKKA)

17. ONE CHEESE SANDWICH, TWO HAM SANDWICHES, ONE LARGE COFFEE, ONE SMALL GLASS OF MILK AND A BEER, PLEASE? (CHEESE SANDWICH= JUUSTOVOILEIPÄ, HAM= KINKKU)

18. TWO SAUSAGE BREADROLLS, THREE WARM MEAT PIES, SOME MUSTARD AND SOME KETCHUP PLEASE? (SAUSAGE BREADROLL= MAKKARASÄMPYLÄ, MEAT PIE= LIHAPIIRAKKA)

19. TWO EGG SANDWICHES AND A PIECE OF LEMON CAKE, PLEASE? (LEMON CAKE= SITRUUNAKAKKU)

20. TWO LARGE TEAS AND SOME MILK AND SOME SUGAR, PLEASE?

21. THREE CUPS OF HERBAL TEA AND TWO HOT CHOCOLATES, PLEASE? (HERBAL TEA= YRTTITEE)

22. TWO SMALL CHOCOLATE ICE CREAMS AND ONE LARGE ICE CREAM, PLEASE? (CHOC ICE CREAM= SUKLAAJÄÄTELÖ, VANILLA= VANILJA)

23. TWO GLASSES OF RED WINE, TWO GLASSES OF COKE AND A GLASS OF SCOTTISH WHISKY, PLEASE? (RED WINE= PUNAVIINI, SCOTTISH= SKOTLANTILAINEN, WHISKY= VISKI)

24. 300 GRAMS OF FINNISH SALMON, PLEASE, AND 150 GRAMS OF EDAM-CHEESE, PLEASE? (GRAMMA)

25. THREE LARGE GLASSES OF WHITE WINE, TWO JALLU- SHOTS AND A GLASS OF ORANGE JUICE, PLEASE? (WHITE WINE= VALKOVIINI, JALLU SHOT= JALLUPAUKKU, ORANGE JUICE= APPELSIINIMEHU)

26. TWO FRESH LOAVES OF BREAD, TWO LITRES OF FAT-FREE MILK AND FOUR SUGAR-FREE, GLUTEN-FREE STRAWBERRY DANISHES, PLEASE? (FRESH= TUORE, LITRE= LITRA, FAT-FREE= RASVATON, SUGAR-FREE= SOKERITON, GLUTEN-FREE= GLUTEENITON, STRAWBERRY DANISH= MANSIKKAVIINERI)

27. TWO TEAS, ONE LARGE BLACK COFFEE, TWO BUTTER EYE BUNS AND TWO BLUEBERRY DOUGHNUTS, PLEASE? (”BUTTER EYE BUN”= VOISILMÄPULLA, BLUEBERRY DOUGHNUT= MUSTIKKAMUNKKI)

28. FIVE HOT SAUSAGES, SOME MUSTARD, A JUG OF COLD WATER AND FIVE LARGE GLASSES, PLEASE? (HOT= KUUMA, JUG= KANNU)

exercises.title: Kuinka sinä sanot suomeksi? (How do you say in Finnish?)
exercises.instruction: Translate the order into Finnish (partitive after numbers 2+ and for quantities/mass nouns).

items.prompt: 1. ONE COFFEE, PLEASE?
items.answer: Yksi kahvi, kiitos.
items.en: One coffee, please.

items.prompt: 2. ONE BLACK COFFEE, PLEASE?
items.answer: Yksi musta kahvi, kiitos.
items.en: One black coffee, please.

items.prompt: 3. TWO COFFEES, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi kahvia, kiitos.
items.en: Two coffees, please.

items.prompt: 4. TWO LARGE COFFEES, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi isoa kahvia, kiitos.
items.en: Two large coffees, please.

items.prompt: 5. THREE LARGE BLACK COFFEES, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kolme isoa mustaa kahvia, kiitos.
items.en: Three large black coffees, please.

items.prompt: 6. A GLASS OF WATER, PLEASE?
items.answer: Lasi vettä, kiitos.
items.en: A glass of water, please.

items.prompt: 7. TWO GLASSES OF WATER, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi lasia vettä, kiitos.
items.en: Two glasses of water, please.

items.prompt: 8. A LARGE GLASS OF BEER, PLEASE?
items.answer: Iso lasi olutta, kiitos.
items.en: A large glass of beer, please.

items.prompt: 9. TWO LARGE GLASSES OF BEER, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi isoa lasia olutta, kiitos.
items.en: Two large glasses of beer, please.

items.prompt: 10. FOUR COLD CIDERS, PLEASE?
items.answer: Neljä kylmää siideriä, kiitos.
items.en: Four cold ciders, please.

items.prompt: 11. THREE PINTS OF BEER, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kolme tuoppia olutta, kiitos.
items.en: Three pints of beer, please.

items.prompt: 12. THREE BOTTLES OF OLVI, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kolme pulloa Olvia, kiitos.
items.en: Three bottles of olvi, please.

items.prompt: 13. A PIECE OF CHOCOLATE CAKE, PLEASE?
items.answer: Pala suklaakakkua, kiitos.
items.en: A piece of chocolate cake, please.

items.prompt: 14. A SMALL COFFEE AND TWO TEAS, PLEASE?
items.answer: Pieni kahvi ja kaksi teetä, kiitos.
items.en: A small coffee and two teas, please.

items.prompt: 15. TWO FRESH CINNAMON BUNS AND TWO APPLE JUICES, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi tuoretta korvapuustia ja kaksi omenamehua, kiitos.
items.en: Two fresh cinnamon buns and two apple juices, please.

items.prompt: 16. THREE WARM KARELIAN PIES AND TWO GLASSES OF WATER, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kolme lämmintä karjalanpiirakkaa ja kaksi lasia vettä, kiitos.
items.en: Three warm karelian pies and two glasses of water, please.

items.prompt: 17. ONE CHEESE SANDWICH, TWO HAM SANDWICHES, ONE LARGE COFFEE, ONE SMALL GLASS OF MILK AND A BEER, PLEASE?
items.answer: Yksi juustovoileipä, kaksi kinkkuvoileipää, yksi iso kahvi, yksi pieni lasi maitoa ja yksi olut, kiitos.
items.en: One cheese sandwich, two ham sandwiches, one large coffee, one small glass of milk and a beer, please.

items.prompt: 18. TWO SAUSAGE BREADROLLS, THREE WARM MEAT PIES, SOME MUSTARD AND SOME KETCHUP PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi makkarasämpylää, kolme lämmintä lihapiirakkaa, sinappia ja ketsuppia, kiitos.
items.en: Two sausage breadrolls, three warm meat pies, some mustard and some ketchup please.

items.prompt: 19. TWO EGG SANDWICHES AND A PIECE OF LEMON CAKE, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi munavoileipää ja pala sitruunakakkua, kiitos.
items.en: Two egg sandwiches and a piece of lemon cake, please.

items.prompt: 20. TWO LARGE TEAS AND SOME MILK AND SOME SUGAR, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi isoa teetä ja maitoa ja sokeria, kiitos.
items.en: Two large teas and some milk and some sugar, please.

items.prompt: 21. THREE CUPS OF HERBAL TEA AND TWO HOT CHOCOLATES, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kolme kuppia yrttiteetä ja kaksi kaakaota, kiitos.
items.en: Three cups of herbal tea and two hot chocolates, please.

items.prompt: 22. TWO SMALL CHOCOLATE ICE CREAMS AND ONE LARGE ICE CREAM, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi pientä suklaajäätelöä ja yksi iso jäätelö, kiitos.
items.en: Two small chocolate ice creams and one large ice cream, please.

items.prompt: 23. TWO GLASSES OF RED WINE, TWO GLASSES OF COKE AND A GLASS OF SCOTTISH WHISKY, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi lasia punaviiniä, kaksi lasia kokista ja lasi skotlantilaista viskiä, kiitos.
items.en: Two glasses of red wine, two glasses of coke and a glass of scottish whisky, please.

items.prompt: 24. 300 GRAMS OF FINNISH SALMON, PLEASE, AND 150 GRAMS OF EDAM-CHEESE, PLEASE?
items.answer: 300 grammaa suomalaista lohta ja 150 grammaa edam-juustoa, kiitos.
items.en: 300 grams of finnish salmon, please, and 150 grams of edam-cheese, please.

items.prompt: 25. THREE LARGE GLASSES OF WHITE WINE, TWO JALLU- SHOTS AND A GLASS OF ORANGE JUICE, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kolme isoa lasia valkoviiniä, kaksi jallupaukkua ja lasi appelsiinimehua, kiitos.
items.en: Three large glasses of white wine, two jallu- shots and a glass of orange juice, please.

items.prompt: 26. TWO FRESH LOAVES OF BREAD, TWO LITRES OF FAT-FREE MILK AND FOUR SUGAR-FREE, GLUTEN-FREE STRAWBERRY DANISHES, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi tuoretta leipää, kaksi litraa rasvatonta maitoa ja neljä sokeritonta, gluteenitonta mansikkaviineriä, kiitos.
items.en: Two fresh loaves of bread, two litres of fat-free milk and four sugar-free, gluten-free strawberry danishes, please.

items.prompt: 27. TWO TEAS, ONE LARGE BLACK COFFEE, TWO BUTTER EYE BUNS AND TWO BLUEBERRY DOUGHNUTS, PLEASE?
items.answer: Kaksi teetä, yksi iso musta kahvi, kaksi voisilmäpullaa ja kaksi mustikkamunkkia, kiitos.
items.en: Two teas, one large black coffee, two butter eye buns and two blueberry doughnuts, please.

items.prompt: 28. FIVE HOT SAUSAGES, SOME MUSTARD, A JUG OF COLD WATER AND FIVE LARGE GLASSES, PLEASE?
items.answer: Viisi kuumaa makkaraa, sinappia, kannu kylmää vettä ja viisi isoa lasia, kiitos.
items.en: Five hot sausages, some mustard, a jug of cold water and five large glasses, please.
